# proxmox_guest_rrddata (Data Source)

Reads guest RRD data points as JSON from `GET /nodes/{node}/{type}/{vmid}/rrddata`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_guest_rrddata" "cpu" {
  type = "qemu"
  node = "pve"
  vmid = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `cf` (String)
- `timeframe` (String)

### Read-Only

- `data` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
